current_formulation: A provenance graph links earlier statements to a claim with the labels identical, paraphrased, textually entailed, triggered, and contradicted.

steps.formulation: Fact-checking assigns a truth value to a claim in its context; who first made the claim is not part of the task.
steps.quote: We define fact-checking to be the assignment of a truth value to a claim made in a particular context.

criticism.quote: who first made a given claim, and how an original claim developed and changed over time

steps.formulation: Edges from earlier statements to a claim carry the labels identical, paraphrased, textually entailed, or motivated.
steps.quote: identical, when a source quotes a statement from another source

criticism.quote: It is important to note that we have not solved the claim provenance problem.
